description: List tables and columns staged on a DataCanvas by water_get_series or water_find_sites. Call this after water_get_series or water_find_sites returns a canvas_id to discover the exact table name and column types before writing a query. Then pass the table name to water_dataframe_query. Requires DataCanvas to be enabled on this server instance. Returns an error if DataCanvas is not available.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by water_get_series or water_find_sites. Identifies the canvas to describe.

name: water_dataframe_describe

canvas_id.description: The canvas ID that was described — pass to water_dataframe_query.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: DataCanvas is not enabled on this server instance. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id does not exist or has expired. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

tables.description: Tables and views on this canvas.

items.description: A staged canvas table or view.

nullable.description: True if the column allows NULL values.

kind.description: Whether this is a base table or a SQL view.

name.description: Table or view name — use as the FROM target in SQL.

row_count.description: Approximate row count for this table (DuckDB estimate; may differ from exact count).

title: Water Dataframe Describe
